'''TK-8332''' was the [[Operating number|designation]] of a [[stormtrooper]] who served in [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] personal stormtrooper [[legion]], [[501st Legion|Vader's Fist]]. After [[Tarvyn Lareka|TK-4601]] requested permission to transfer to the active-duty unit during the remainder of the [[Secret mission to Tatooine|battle]] aboard the ''[[Tantive IV]]'', TK-8332 and [[TK-7624]] were sent to escort [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] to [[Darth]] Vader.<ref name="The Bucket" />
